messages:
Nina R: Heads-up: overnight invoice preview shows a consistent +0.8% bump for ~40 US tenants around 00:00 UTC today. Looks like small rounding leakage.
Carlos M: any correlation with the quota-heartbeat cadence change last week? we moved to 60s windows.
eng-analytics: quick aggregation flags tenants with rounded vs raw mismatch; many stream sessions crossing minute boundaries are double-rounded.
Sophie L: we currently ceil per-heartbeat to keep emits integer. When sessions span heartbeats fractions get rounded on both sides -> overcount. Example: 1 token over 90s -> 1 + 1 reported.
Nina R: short-term: emit both raw_tokens (float) and rounded_tokens (int). aggregator will prefer raw_tokens if present. Low-risk compatibility path.
Carlos M: also add session_continuity_id so aggregator can join adjacent heartbeats deterministically.
eng-analytics: detection query prepared to find affected previews; backfill plan is to re-run previews for days with >0.25 token overcount for a tenant.
Sophie L: timeline: emitter PR today -> canary 20% proxies 2h; aggregator PR tomorrow -> canary 10% ingest 1h. After canary, run detection and schedule backfill.
BillingBot: opening INC-2026-032 for invoice-preview rounding deltas and tagging affected orgs.
Nina R: owners assigned. Please paste PR links and monitor duplicate counts. Thanks :+1:
